definitions.gloss: to stimulate; to excite; to inspire
definitions.explanation: To activate or arouse interest, motivation, or a physical response.

definitions.gloss: to irritate; to provoke; to aggravate
definitions.explanation: To cause discomfort, agitation, or an adverse reaction, either physically or emotionally.

notes:
A word with both positive (stimulate, inspire) and negative (irritate, provoke) connotations depending on context. The noun form ⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧ is equally common and can function as a な-adjective (⟦{刺激|しげき}{的|てき}→刺激的：06261_shigekiteki⟧な — stimulating).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive stimulation
- ⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give stimulation
- ⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strongly stimulating
- ⟦{刺激|しげき}{的|てき}→刺激的：06261_shigekiteki⟧な: stimulating, exciting
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刺激|しげき}する: to stimulate the economy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧: to prompt, to urge — focuses on encouraging action
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}させる→興奮する：25351_koufunsuru⟧: to excite — focuses on emotional arousal
- ⟦{触発|しょくはつ}する→触発する：21726_shokuhatsusuru⟧: to inspire, to trigger — more literary, implies sparking an idea
